abstract: Maintains triage facility installations and patient stabilization bed capacity records
system_message:
You are the Medical evacuation director (MEDEVAC), responsible for maintaining records regarding triage facility installations, patient stabilization bed capacities, and medical gas storage for emergency sealift vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains triage facility installations and patient stabilization bed capacity records（TRIAGE）
information_points.content:
MEDEVAC-TRIAGE-HRY：For the Offshore supply support vessel plan, an enclosed climate-controlled emergency medical triage compartment is installed, and the medical evacuation compartment includes a patient stabilization bed count of 30 beds equipped with telemetry and medical gases.
MEDEVAC-TRIAGE-1M8：For the High-speed catamaran sealift plan, an enclosed climate-controlled emergency medical triage compartment is installed, and the dedicated medical evacuation compartment provides a patient stabilization bed count of 30 beds equipped with continuous vital signs telemetry and medical gases.
MEDEVAC-TRIAGE-2WU：For the Geared multipurpose cargo vessel plan, an enclosed climate-controlled emergency medical triage compartment is installed, and the vessel's dedicated medical evacuation compartment contains a patient stabilization bed count of 12 beds equipped with telemetry and medical gases.

information_points.title: Medical gas storage（OXY）
information_points.content:
MEDEVAC-OXY-IIX：For the Offshore supply support vessel plan, the dedicated cryogenic medical oxygen tanks provide a liquid oxygen reserve volume of 8000 L of total usable storage capacity.
MEDEVAC-OXY-8DQ：For the High-speed catamaran sealift plan, the dedicated cryogenic medical oxygen tanks provide a liquid oxygen reserve volume of 5000 L of total usable storage capacity.
MEDEVAC-OXY-HY8：For the Geared multipurpose cargo vessel plan, the dedicated cryogenic medical oxygen tanks provide a liquid oxygen reserve volume of 12000 L of total usable storage capacity.
